record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: For a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra, is every grading-restricted generalized module of finite length completely reducible exactly when, for every positive integer n, the nth cohomology of the algebra with coefficients in any bimodule is zero? In particular, does the same equivalence hold for a grading-restricted vertex algebra viewed as a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra, allowing the left and right bimodule actions to differ?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.1. Every grading-restricted generalized module of finite length for a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra is completely reducible if and only if for n in Z+, the n-th cohomology of the meromorphic open-string vertex algebra with coefficients in any bimodule is 0. In particular, every grading-restricted generalized module of finite length for a grading-restricted vertex algebra is completely reducible if and only if for n in Z+, the n-th cohomology of the grading-restricted vertex algebra viewed as a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra with coefficients in any bimodule (whose left and right actions can be different) is 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. A meromorphic open-string vertex algebra (MOSVA) is a Z-graded vector space V = ⊕_{n∈Z} V_(n) with grading-restriction conditions (dim V_(n) < ∞ and V_(n) = 0 for n sufficiently negative), equipped with a vertex map Y_V: V ⊗ V → V[[x, x^{-1}]] and a vacuum 1 ∈ V_(0), satisfying the rationality, associativity, identity, creation, d/dx, and grading axioms appropriate to the non-commutative (open-string) setting (in which Y_V(u, x_1)Y_V(v, x_2) and Y_V(v, x_2)Y_V(u, x_1) are not required to be analytic continuations of each other, but products and iterates of vertex operators converge to rational functions on suitable domains). A V-bimodule W is a graded vector space carrying compatible left and right vertex operator actions in the MOSVA sense. For a V-bimodule W and a positive integer n, one has the n-th cohomology group H^n(V, W) defined via the chain complex of "shuffle-compatible" maps from configuration spaces of n points to W (the cohomology theory developed for MOSVAs that generalizes Huang's cohomology of vertex algebras). A grading-restricted generalized V-module is a graded module M = ⊕_{α∈C, n∈Z} M_{[α]+n} with dim M_{[α]+n} < ∞ and finite-dimensional generalized L(0)-eigenspaces, vanishing in sufficiently negative real parts. Such a module is completely reducible if every grading-restricted generalized V-submodule has a graded complement that is also a submodule.

Problem. Prove or disprove the following equivalence:

(a) Every grading-restricted generalized V-module of finite length is completely reducible.

(b) For every positive integer n and every V-bimodule W, H^n(V, W) = 0.

In particular, establish the analogous equivalence for a grading-restricted vertex algebra V (in the usual commutative sense), regarded as a MOSVA, where the bimodule W is allowed to have left and right V-actions that need not coincide.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture remains open in full generality. Partial progress has been made: Huang and Qi proved (under a convergence assumption) that vanishing of the first cohomology with coefficients in any bimodule implies complete reducibility of finite-length modules satisfying a composability condition, giving one direction in degree n = 1. The full equivalence over all positive degrees n and all bimodules has not, to current evidence, been established.

status_evidence.title: The first cohomology, derivations and the reductivity of a (meromorphic open-string) vertex algebra
status_evidence.snippet: A criterion for the complete reducibility of modules satisfying a composability condition for a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra V is given using the first cohomology.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the n=1 direction of the conjectured equivalence under a convergence/composability assumption.

status_evidence.title: On the extensions of the left modules for a meromorphic open-string vertex algebra, I
status_evidence.snippet: If a MOSVA has vanishing first cohomology for every bimodule, then its left modules of finite length satisfying a composability condition are completely reducible.
status_evidence.claim: Further work in the program addressing the conjecture; the full equivalence is not asserted to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture on complete reducibility of finite-length modules iff vanishing of n-th cohomology for all positive n and all bimodules.
status_evidence.claim: The statement is posed as an open conjecture.
